fusions.name: Galloping Blaze
fusions.desc: A thundering blow of flame that deals 12 damage, up to 2 times as much at its full 7-tile reach, knocks the target back 3 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: A trampling blow that deals 16 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Blazing Mare
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a mare of flame that fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you call it.

fusions.name: Built-Up Momentum
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
